# Pico CSS

Pico CSS **2.1.1**, vendored unchanged under the MIT license in `PICO-LICENSE.md`.
No CDN or browser network dependency; no frontend build step.

Upstream sources (retrieved 2026-10-19):

- https://github.com/picocss/pico/blob/v2.1.1/css/pico.min.css
- https://github.com/picocss/pico/blob/v2.1.1/LICENSE.md

SHA-256:

- `pico.min.css`: `fbc9a63fc9fc9f72d12fd7fc9806e11fa9f77ae4f9cad146b27003a1119ba3db`
- `PICO-LICENSE.md`: `afaff063e044233f917b7807dccab022f09dca474f92b642846bee4850655bbf`

For upgrades, fetch a named upstream release, retain its license, update these hashes,
and verify the dashboard in light/dark themes and narrow/wide viewports. Pico includes
inline SVG form affordances inside its CSS; it loads no external fonts or images.
